advancement.hollowlight.depth.root.descr: Find the shrine that is not for water.
advancement.hollowlight.depth.root.title: The Dedication Stone
advancement.hollowlight.depth.the_drowne: Wade into the halls that remember the winter.
advancement.hollowlight.depth.the_forgot: Go down one step further than anyone came back from.
Stand in the Heart of the Hollow.
advancement.hollowlight.depth.the_living: Reach the walls that answer when you lean on them.
advancement.hollowlight.depth.the_memori: Find the rooms she gave away whole.
advancement.hollowlight.ending.carrying_: Give the Heart a name it cannot keep.
advancement.hollowlight.ending.extinguis: Put out the last lamp and let her rest.
advancement.hollowlight.ending.keeping.d: Take up the wick. Keep the lamp lit for whoever comes next.
advancement.hollowlight.hidden.a_thing_t: Kill the one resident of the labyrinth that never fought back.
advancement.hollowlight.hidden.four_note: Restore the music box at a memory altar.
Four Notes and a Fifth That Is Not There
advancement.hollowlight.hidden.two_notes: Blow Iver's whistle somewhere it can be heard.
advancement.hollowlight.hidden.you_did_n: Leave the Sorrow alone. It was never going to hurt you.
advancement.hollowlight.story.a_lamp_is_: Learn what her father taught her about light.
advancement.hollowlight.story.a_window_u: Find the kitchen that should not exist this deep.
advancement.hollowlight.story.every_day_: Count the tallies and realise they stop.
advancement.hollowlight.story.four_trade: Hear how she spent her voice.
Find the first words he scratched into stone.
I Am Here. I Have Been Here.
advancement.hollowlight.story.it_was_nev: Read the last marks. He forgave her before she ever came down.
advancement.hollowlight.story.nine_names: Read the first page of Mara's journal.
advancement.hollowlight.story.she_does_n: Meet the Lamplighter and be asked a question.
advancement.hollowlight.story.she_is_ask: Understand that the whisper was never for the dark.
advancement.hollowlight.story.somebody_w: Hold the proof of what happened to Iver Vane.
Somebody Was Always Looking For Me
advancement.hollowlight.story.the_first_: Discover what she gave the labyrinth first.
advancement.hollowlight.story.the_last_e: Read what she wrote by touch at the bottom of the world.
advancement.hollowlight.story.the_quiet_: Finish what eleven years of walking could not.
advancement.hollowlight.story.the_sound_: Learn the second price she paid.
advancement.hollowlight.story.two_pillow: Find the bed in the Memorial Depths.
advancement.hollowlight.story.what_it_wa: Read the terms of the bargain.
advancement.hollowlight.story.where_the_: Read the dedication and understand it is a warning.
advancement.hollowlight.story.you_walked: Understand what the shouting was, seven years too late.
block.hollowlight.memory_altar.hum: The altar hums, very slowly, and waits.
block.hollowlight.sealed_gate.locked: The gate does not know you.
block.hollowlight.sealed_gate.opens: The gate remembers the key and steps aside.
entity.hollowlight.lampkeeper.name: The Lamplighter
gui.hollowlight.ending.body: She is not asking the dark. She has never been asking the dark. Choose what the lamp does next.
gui.hollowlight.ending.title: The Last Lamp
gui.hollowlight.journal.title: The Lamplighter's Journal
gui.hollowlight.map.title: The Cracked Lens
gui.hollowlight.undiscovered: You have not found this yet. Somewhere below, it is still written.
hollowlight.ascend.surface: You come up into daylight that does not suit you anymore.
hollowlight.descend.1: The air changes. Dust, and old lamp smoke.
hollowlight.descend.2: Your boots go quiet. There is water in the walls now.
hollowlight.descend.3: The stone is warm. It moves when you lean on it.
hollowlight.descend.4: A window. A curtain. A table set for three.
hollowlight.descend.5: You can hear a lamp burning. It is the biggest sound you have ever heard.
hollowlight.ending.keep.epilogue: Above, the villagers notice the shrine lamp has been relit. They do not notice it burns differently now, nor that whoever keeps it never comes up for bread.
hollowlight.ending.keep.one: You lift the wick out of her hands. It does not go out.
hollowlight.ending.keep.three: Somewhere below, a voice that is almost yours begins to say a name.
hollowlight.ending.keep.two: The labyrinth settles around you like a house.
hollowlight.ending.release.epilogue: The lamps go out, upstream of her, like people leaving a room they were only waiting in. In the morning the shrine is full of daylight and the mine is only a mine.
hollowlight.ending.release.one: You put your hand on the wick.
hollowlight.ending.release.three: She says the name correctly, once, to your face.
hollowlight.ending.release.two: She looks at you with eyes she gave away eleven years ago.
hollowlight.ending.return.epilogue: You climb for a long time. It is lighter than going down, and at the ninth step there is bread. You eat it, because it is for you.
hollowlight.ending.return.missing: You would have to be carrying something of his for that to work.
hollowlight.ending.return.one: You say his name into the Heart.
hollowlight.ending.return.three: The dust goes quiet. Somebody, somewhere, stops waiting.
hollowlight.ending.return.two: It is the one thing the Heart cannot keep: something that was already being carried.
hollowlight.gate.sealed: The threshold will not open yet. Something below is not finished.
hollowlight.key.refuses: This lock was cut deeper than the key.
hollowlight.key.wrong_place: The key turns in your hand and finds nothing to turn.
hollowlight.lampkeeper.death: The lamp goes out of her hands, and for one breath she is only a woman in the dark.
hollowlight.lampkeeper.phase2: The Lamplighter stops. She turns her head as if she has heard something upstairs.
hollowlight.lampkeeper.phase3: She stops asking. She starts taking.
hollowlight.lore.reread: You have read this before. It says the same thing.
hollowlight.sanity.low: Something is walking behind you. Probably.
hollowlight.sanity.thin: The corridors feel thinner than they did.
hollowlight.tooltip.open_map: Right-click to look through the lens
hollowlight.weeping.death: You killed the only thing down here that never hurt anybody.
hollowlight.weeping.spared: You walk past. It stops crying for a moment, which is worse.
hollowlight.weeping.struck: It does not fight back. It only cries harder.
item.hollowlight.bitterroot_tea.flavour: Hot, bitter, and it makes the walls stop moving.
item.hollowlight.bone_stitch.flavour: A needle of bone and a thread of something that was alive.
item.hollowlight.broken_music_box.flavou: Four notes and a comb that will not turn.
item.hollowlight.broken_music_box.plays: Four notes, and a fifth one that is not there.
item.hollowlight.carved_token.flavour: Number seven, scratched by hand. Never handed in.
item.hollowlight.cracked_lens.flavour: It shows you the ground you have already given your feet to.
item.hollowlight.drowned_breath.flavour: Tastes of river ice. Your lungs forget to complain.
item.hollowlight.drowned_key.flavour: The metal has gone the colour of deep water.
item.hollowlight.glass_bolt.flavour: A sliver of glass that carries light down its whole length.
item.hollowlight.heart_key.flavour: It is warm when you are not looking at it.
item.hollowlight.heart_of_the_hollow.fla: The thing she could not give away, because it was the reason.
item.hollowlight.hollow_ember.flavour: Something that burned here before the stone cooled.
item.hollowlight.iver_whistle.flavour: Two notes, both wrong, and the only voice that was ever kind.
item.hollowlight.lamp_oil.flavour: Rendered from something that did not want to be oil.
item.hollowlight.lamplighter_lantern.emp: The wick is dry. You need lamp oil.
item.hollowlight.lamplighter_lantern.fla: A lamp is a promise, not a light.
item.hollowlight.lamplighter_lantern.use: Right-click to set it down or hold the flame
item.hollowlight.lamplighters_band.flavo: Iron, worn shiny on the inside. It was somebody's comfort.
item.hollowlight.lamplighters_journal.fl: Every page she could still read, in her own hand.
item.hollowlight.lantern_chain.flavour: Lamplit links on a length of chain. It jingles before it lands.
item.hollowlight.living_fiber.flavour: It moves when the light does.
item.hollowlight.luminous_flask.flavour: A small sun you can throw at the floor.
item.hollowlight.memory_draught.flavour: Somebody else's calm, borrowed without asking.
item.hollowlight.memory_shard.flavour: A splinter of lamp glass with somebody's afternoon caught in it.
item.hollowlight.miner_shiv.flavour: A flint edge and a stick. Enough to make somebody hesitate.
item.hollowlight.oiled_wick.flavour: Trimmed and ready. Trimming a wick is almost a prayer.
item.hollowlight.pale_scale.flavour: It is still faintly warm to the touch.
item.hollowlight.rusted_key.flavour: Cut for one door, a long time ago.
item.hollowlight.rusted_pickhammer.flavo: Heavy, unbalanced, and the only thing with a point on it.
item.hollowlight.salt_of_hollowmere.flav: The village was paid for out of the ground once.
item.hollowlight.seventh_seam_dust.flavo: Fine, grey, and it does not settle.
item.hollowlight.sweet_ash.flavour: Sweet and grey. You feel braver than you are.
item.hollowlight.torn_journal_page.flavo: Somebody wrote this down in the dark, in a hurry.
item.hollowlight.unsent_letter.flavour: Folded four times, worn soft at the creases. Never posted.
item.hollowlight.water_stained_photograp: Two children, two pairs of boots, no faces.
item.hollowlight.wax_bandage.flavour: Waxed cloth. It smells faintly of somebody's kitchen.
item.hollowlight.wickbow.flavour: A bowstring of wick. It does not fire arrows.
subtitles.hollowlight.entity.choir.sing: The drowned recite a list of names
